legendaries.name: Insight Lens
legendaries.effectText: Weak points take an extra +0.5x damage.

legendaries.name: Failover Core
legendaries.effectText: Once per fight, survive a hit that would defeat you, with 1 health.

legendaries.name: Elimination Engine
legendaries.effectText: Removes one wrong answer from every question.

_affixNote: Random affixes on Uncommon, Rare and Epic gear. Each stat is [lowest, highest] and is rolled when the item drops. Stats use the same names as the skill tree and ascension (see js/ascension.js). {stat} in text shows the rolled number. minTier: the lowest tier that can roll it.

affixes.name: Salted
affixes.concept: Salting: adding random data to a password before hashing it, so the same passwords hash differently.

affixes.name: Hashed
affixes.concept: Hashing: turning data into a fixed-length fingerprint that changes if the data changes.

affixes.name: Zero-Day
affixes.text: Your first hit each fight deals +{firstHitBonus}%
affixes.concept: Zero-day: a flaw the vendor doesn't know about yet, so there's no patch for it.

affixes.name: Tokenized
affixes.concept: Tokenization: swapping sensitive data for a random token that's useless if stolen.

affixes.name: Escalated
affixes.concept: Privilege escalation: gaining more access than you were given.

affixes.name: Obfuscated
affixes.concept: Obfuscation: making code or data hard to read, to hide what it does.

affixes.name: Sandboxed
affixes.text: Blocks the first enemy hit each fight
affixes.concept: Sandboxing: running something in an isolated space where it can't harm the system.

affixes.name: Hardened
affixes.concept: Hardening: shrinking a system's attack surface by removing what it doesn't need.

affixes.name: Signed
affixes.concept: Digital signature: proves who sent something and that it wasn't changed.

affixes.name: of Persistence
affixes.text: +{streakDamage}% damage per right answer in a row (up to 5)
affixes.concept: Persistence: an attacker keeping access to a system over time.

affixes.name: of Least Privilege
affixes.text: Take {lowHpDefense}% less damage below half health
affixes.concept: Least privilege: give each user only the access they need to do their job.

affixes.name: of Availability
affixes.concept: Availability: systems and data are there when people need them.

affixes.name: of Exfiltration
affixes.concept: Exfiltration: secretly moving data out of a network.

affixes.name: of Reconnaissance
affixes.concept: Reconnaissance: gathering information about a target before an attack.

affixes.name: of Countermeasures
affixes.text: When an enemy misses, hit back for {counterOnMiss}% of your last hit
affixes.concept: Countermeasure: an action that reduces a threat or a vulnerability.

affixes.name: of Deception
affixes.text: Enemies that hit you take {thorns}% of the damage back
affixes.concept: Deception technology: decoys like honeypots that turn an attacker's moves against them.

affixes.name: of Redundancy
affixes.concept: Redundancy: spare power, servers or links, so one failure doesn't stop everything.

affixes.name: Unpatched
affixes.text: +{damage}% skill damage, but enemies hit {dodge}% more often
affixes.concept: Unpatched: a known flaw left unfixed. Useful to an attacker, dangerous to own.

affixes.name: Legacy
affixes.text: +{hp} max health, but {time} fewer seconds per question
affixes.concept: Legacy system: old technology still in use, often unsupported and hard to secure.

affixes.name: Shadow IT
affixes.text: +{loot}% gear drop chance, but take {defense}% more damage
affixes.concept: Shadow IT: technology people use without the IT team's approval.

_setNote: Set items: 3 pieces each (Tool, Armor, Module). Pieces are Epic gear with a fixed name, drawn in setColor. They drop in their own area (area id), or from any area's finale boss ("finale"). Bonuses turn on when you wear that many pieces.

sets.name: CIA Triad
sets.concept: The CIA triad: confidentiality, integrity and availability, the three goals of security.

bonuses.text: Balanced triad: +5% more damage, +10% max health and +5 seconds per question

sets.name: Cyber Kill Chain
sets.concept: The Cyber Kill Chain: the steps of an attack, from reconnaissance to actions on objectives.

bonuses.text: Your first hit each fight deals +50%
Each right answer in a row adds +8% damage (up to 5), a miss resets it

sets.name: Zero Trust Architecture
sets.concept: Zero trust: never trust, always verify. Every request is checked, even from inside the network.

bonuses.text: Never trust, always verify: the first enemy hit each fight is blocked

sets.name: Incident Response Kit
sets.concept: Incident response: preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.

bonuses.text: Recovery: once per fight, when you drop below 30% health, heal back to 60%

sets.name: Governance Charter
sets.concept: Governance: the policies, standards and oversight that steer an organization's security.

bonuses.text: Due diligence: wrong answers still deal 25% damage, and +10% gear drop chance

sets.name: PKI Chain of Trust
sets.concept: Chain of trust: each certificate is signed by the one above it, up to a trusted root CA.

bonuses.text: Signed by the root: +10% more crit chance, and critical hits deal 3x instead of 2x
